name: Dark Matter Lens
lore: Focuses gravity, not light.
research: The Dark Sector - Most of the universe's mass does not interact with light. Unlocks the Dark Matter Halo Collector.

name: Gravitic Lens Element
lore: A dark-matter lens trimmed so its Einstein ring falls exactly where you need it.
research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

name: Photonic Lens
lore: A lithography lens. Not consumed - it focuses light onto wafers forever.

name: Tesseract Lens
lore: Focuses light through the fourth dimension. A lithography catalyst.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Closed Timelike Curve
lore: A path through spacetime that ends where - and when - it started.
research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

name: Compactified Circle
lore: A whole dimension rolled up into a circle smaller than a Planck length.
research: Compactification - Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

name: Hopf Fibration
lore: A 3-sphere unwound into circles, every two of them linked.
research: The Transfinite Hierarchy - Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.

name: Recombinant DNA
lore: A double helix spliced from more than one creature.
research: Genomics - Four letters, three billion of them. Unlocks the Gene Sequencer, recombinant DNA and engineered enzymes.

name: Temporal Knot
lore: A worldline tied into a knot. Untie it and something happens twice.
research: Temporal Mechanics - The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.

name: Well-Ordering Charm
lore: Every descent ends somewhere. Carry it in the Transfinite Hierarchy.

name: Calabi-Yau Manifold
lore: Six compact dimensions, folded small enough to hold.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Differential Manifold
lore: A space that is flat up close and curved far away - the stage on which relativity is written.
research: Calculus - Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals - and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.

name: G₂ Manifold
lore: Seven curled-up dimensions whose symmetry is the automorphism group of the octonions.
research: Compactification - Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

name: Klein Bottle
lore: A bottle with no inside. It only fits together in four dimensions.
research: Geometric Topology - Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.

name: Omnicellular Genome
lore: One genome that can build any creature in any dimension.
research: Panspermia - Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.

name: Dimensional Stabiliser Matrix
lore: Compactified dimensions woven tight with quantum strings, so they stay rolled up under load.
research: String Theory - Every particle is a vibrating string. Unlocks the String Resonance Loom.

name: Transfinite Weave
lore: Cloth with more threads than there are numbers to count them. Endgame assemblies are stitched on it.
research: Transfinite Mathematics - Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.

name: Arbor Simulacrum
lore: A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Cryocooler Unit
lore: A closed-cycle superfluid refrigerator. Superconductors stop superconducting without one.
research: Cryogenics - Near absolute zero, matter forgets it is many particles. Superfluids and Bose-Einstein condensates.

name: Negentropy Cell
lore: Order, bottled. Entropy flows backwards inside.
research: Thermodynamics of Information - Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.

name: Absolute Infinity
lore: Larger than every infinity. It cannot be conceived - and yet here it is.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Eternity Catalyst
lore: Time flows through it without passing. Required (not consumed) by the final processes.
research: The Simulation Hypothesis - If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

name: Higgs Catalyst
lore: A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Required (not consumed) by mass-altering processes.
research: Mass Manipulation - Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

name: Omega Point
lore: The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Omnilex
lore: Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Omniscience Catalyst
lore: All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.

name: Oracle's Lemma
lore: Creative mode only. Use inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers to have it count as solved.

name: Proof of Everything
lore: What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it.

name: Spacetime Catalyst
lore: A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime. Required (not consumed) by hyperdimensional processes.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Theory of Everything
lore: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model in one equation. It fits on a T-shirt.
research: Theory of Everything - Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.

name: Biosphere Compendium
lore: One of every creature that can be eaten, pressed into one. Do not eat.

name: Buckyball Cage
lore: Sixty carbon atoms arranged like a football - with room inside for one more atom.
research: Nanochemistry - Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.

name: Einstein Field Core
lore: Matter tells spacetime how to curve; spacetime tells matter how to move. Both halves, in one core.
research: General Relativity - Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

name: Graviton Wisp Core
lore: The heart of a Graviton Wisp: a closed loop of gravity that still pulls on your hand.

name: Hypersphere Fragment
lore: A curved piece of a sphere with a 3-dimensional surface.

name: Protostar Core
lore: A collapsing knot of nebular gas, hot enough to glow but not yet to fuse.
research: Stellar Evolution - Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

name: Red Giant Envelope
lore: The swollen outer layers of a dying star, a hundred times wider than it once was.
research: Stellar Evolution - Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

name: Minimal Synthetic Cell
lore: The smallest genome that can still be alive, written from scratch.
research: Synthetic Biology - Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.

name: White Dwarf Core
lore: A star's carbon heart, the size of a planet and held up only by electron degeneracy.
research: Stellar Evolution - Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

name: Entangled Photon Pair
lore: Measure one and the other already knows.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Lepton Triplet
lore: Electron, muon and tau - with a neutrino shadowing each.
research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

name: Glueball Core
lore: A particle made of nothing but the force carriers that hold quarks together.
research: Accelerator Physics - Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.

name: Muonic Catalyst
lore: Swap an electron for a muon and atoms shrink 200 times - close enough to fuse cold.
research: Exotic Chemistry - Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.

name: Positronium Hydride
lore: A molecule made of a hydrogen atom and an atom of matter bound to antimatter. It lasts a nanosecond - unless you trap it.
research: Exotic Chemistry - Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.

name: Strange Matter Pellet
lore: Up, down and strange quarks. Possibly contagious.
research: Thermodynamics of Information - Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.

name: Cherenkov Wafer
lore: A wafer sliced from a Cherenkov boule.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Metamaterial Substrate
lore: The blank on which every circuit board is built.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Cosmic Circuit Board
lore: A board laid across a Calabi-Yau manifold.
research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

name: Cosmic Logic Wafer
lore: Etched with a lens made of a cosmic string. Each trace is a light-year long, folded.
research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

name: Degenerate Armour Plate
lore: Neutronium held at stellar-core pressure by a spacetime-alloy frame. Starlight does not dent it.
research: Compact Stars - Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

name: Graphene Sheet
lore: Carbon one atom thick. Stronger than steel, conducts better than copper.
research: Nanochemistry - Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.

name: Hawking Absorber Plate
lore: Metamaterial tuned to soak up the thermal glow a black hole gives off as it evaporates.
research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

name: Hyperdimensional Logic Wafer
lore: Circuits laid out in four dimensions, folded flat.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Hyperdimensional Wafer
lore: A wafer with more surface than its area allows.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Neutronium Plate
lore: Rolled to a thickness of a few femtometres.

name: Photonic Circuit Board
lore: A board of light-guides.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Photonic Logic Wafer
lore: Engraved with waveguides instead of wires.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Quadrupole Pole Tip
lore: A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres. Four of them squeeze a beam into focus.
research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.
